T: He dreamed up Las Vegas. Then he blew the budget.
D: A charismatic gangster builds a lavish casino hotel in the Nevada desert.
P: Serve dessert when Ben first stands in the empty desert and pictures his casino.
S: Warm buckwheat blini 5 minutes at 180C, top with a spoon of crème fraîche, salmon roe or caviar and snipped chives.
the classic forties supper club starter
Prawns poached and iced, hung over coupes of shredded iceberg, Marie Rose with a splash of brandy, paprika and lemon.
the 1940s Hollywood crowd Ben ran with
Little gem lettuce cups filled with chopped chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, egg, tomato and blue cheese, a spoon of red wine vinaigrette over the top.
M: flambéed tableside, like the opening night
Flatten scotch fillet, sear hot, set aside. Shallot and garlic in butter, flame with brandy, add Dijon, Worcestershire, stock and cream, reduce, steak back in.
carved to order on opening night, black tie
Rib roast salted overnight and roasted pink, carved thick with its own jus, horseradish and popovers straight from a hot tin.
W: raspberry cream for the hotel's namesake
4 whites whipped with 220g caster sugar, cornflour and vinegar, baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Top with cream folded with crushed raspberries.
K: Gin, fresh lime and soda water over ice, crisp and sharp, the cocktail of the era.

dishes.make_ahead: Salt the beef the day before; make the popover batter 1 hour ahead

ingredients.item: beef rib roast, on the bone

steps.text: Rub the beef with 2 tsp of the salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Rub with the pepper, garlic and rosemary and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C until 52C in the middle, about 1 hour 20 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, the last 1 tsp salt and half the butter into a smooth batter and rest it.
Rest the beef under foil. Turn the oven to 220C, brush a muffin tin with the rest of the butter and heat it for 5 minutes.
Fill the hot tin halfway with batter and bake until tall and crisp, about 25 minutes. Do not open the door.
Simmer the pan juices with the stock for the jus. Carve the beef thick and serve with the popovers, jus and horseradish.

veg.make_ahead: Make the popover batter 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, 1 tsp of the salt and half the butter into a smooth batter and rest it.
Toss the mushrooms with the oil, the rest of the salt, pepper, garlic and rosemary and roast for 20 minutes.
Brush a muffin tin with the rest of the butter and heat it for 5 minutes.
Fill the hot tin halfway with batter and bake until tall and crisp, about 25 minutes. Do not open the door.
Simmer the mushroom pan juices with the stock for the jus and serve with the popovers and horseradish.

edition.tagline: He dreamed up Las Vegas. Then he blew the budget.
edition.cue: Serve dessert when Ben first sees the Nevada desert.

s.how: Warm 16 buckwheat blini at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, half a teaspoon of salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve straight away on a silver tray.

s.note: the 1940s Hollywood crowd Ben ran with
s.how: Poach 2 chicken breasts (about 400g) for 12 minutes, cool and dice. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble. Boil 2 eggs for 9 minutes and chop. Dice 1 avocado and 2 tomatoes. Fill 12 little gem leaves with everything, scatter 60g crumbled blue cheese and spoon over red wine vinaigrette.

m.note: flambéed tableside, like the opening night
m.how: Flatten 4 scotch fillet steaks, about 800g, and sear hot for 2 minutes a side, then rest. In the same pan, soften 2 chopped shallots and 1 garlic clove in 30g butter, add 60ml brandy and flame. Stir in 1 tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 150ml beef stock and 150ml cream and reduce 4 minutes. Return the steaks to coat.

w.note: raspberry cream for the hotel's namesake
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to soft peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp white vinegar, spread into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Whip 300ml thickened cream and fold through 125g crushed raspberries. Pile on top just before serving.

d.how: Fill 4 highball glasses with ice. Add 45ml gin and the juice of half a lime to each, drop in the squeezed shell and top with 150ml soda water.
